name: lpg-modeler
description: Visual modeling for labeled property graphs, with Ladybug, Neo4j, SHACL and OWL generation.

lpg.targets.neo4j.edition.description: Neo4j edition. Community cannot enforce existence or node key constraints.

lpg.targets.falkordb.graphKey.description: FalkorDB: the Redis key the graph lives under. Empty means the model's own namespace prefix names it.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code theme's background and text, with borders, boxes and edges derived from them for contrast.
Solarized Light, with text and accents darkened to meet WCAG contrast.
Solarized Dark, with text and accents lightened to meet WCAG contrast.
Black on white, maximum contrast; also suits screenshots for documents.
lpg.canvas.theme.markdownDescription: Color theme of the model canvas. Also chosen from the **Theme** picker in the canvas toolbar. Any color can be overridden below.

lpg.canvas.colors.background.patternErrorMessage: A hex color such as #1a5e8f, or empty to use the theme's color.
lpg.canvas.colors.background.markdownDescription: Canvas and panel background. A hex color such as `#1a5e8f`; empty uses the theme's color. Also set from **Colors…** in the canvas toolbar.
